development_period: 2018, previously observed development data, used for recipe and epoch selection
selection: maximum daily top10 true positives, AP breaks ties, then earliest epoch and declared recipe order
final_refit_contract: Once root freezes selected recipe/epochs, refit three seeds on all permitted development records through 2018; average their scores; all classical controls receive the same fit period; evaluate 2019 once without further tuning.
limits: Synthetic data; event-time features do not prove ingestion availability.
All 2018 results are development results; six recipes and ten epochs explicitly searched.
No identifier or label features; historical signed means are numeric predictors, not positive spending claims.
Weighted neural scores are not calibrated fraud probabilities.
No architecture superiority unless matched ablation results support it.
